description:
What this is. This is how you ask the clinic to check someone's health: who it is for, which check, and the dates they can go in. You do not fill this in by hand — you start it from the person's page, or from a list if you are booking many people at once, and it is sent to the clinic straight away. Come back here to see whether they have been yet.

A guided tour. Opening this step walks you through the page one box at a time and explains what each one is for. You can start it again whenever you like with the small i button at the top of the page.

Where to find it. To see the ones already there, open Clinic Test Request from the menu on the left.
name: Track Clinic Test Requests
title: Clinic Test Request — booking a health check
